name: Republican Party
overview: Scripture calls believers to act justly and compassionately toward those in need, emphasizing care for strangers and the poor as a reflection of obedience to God. The biblical wisdom highlights the danger of oppressing the vulnerable to gain wealth and encourages honest labor as a means of provision. Additionally, it exhorts the faithful to speak up for those who cannot defend themselves and to intervene on behalf of those facing destruction, underscoring a Christ-centered responsibility to protect and provide for the marginalized.
